scene: You shoot out the slide into a sunny courtyard filled with foam.
picture: Pixel art side-view of a bouncy courtyard. Far left curls the yellow slide exit. In the centre, the boy with messy dark hair and red sneakers stands holding his skateboard. Left lies a heap of turquoise foam. Right sits a brass water valve, and far right an open wooden garden gate leads outward.
shown: a bubbling mound of turquoise foam sits piled on the left
a large brass water valve bolted to a pipe on the right
a swinging wooden garden gate standing unlatched at the far right
